name: three_bar_momentum_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, when three consecutive 5-second bars each close in the same direction (close > open for bulls) with both volume and bar range expanding monotonically, it indicates an institutional TWAP or algo order is still actively routing — each successive 5-second slice consumes more liquidity at a wider spread than the previous, signaling the order has not yet completed its fill. Unlike individual FnO stocks where this pattern can reflect a single large order, NIFTY's index composition means three expanding-volume bullish bars reflect aggregate buy-side imbalance from multiple participants simultaneously, making continuation more persistent. The next 15-90 seconds captures the residual 'still-filling' phase before the algorithmic slice completes and the imbalance normalizes.
core_signal_oneliner: Three consecutive 5s bars in the same direction with monotonically expanding volume and range, signaling an active TWAP order still routing
